recognize_zh: 原始細胞胞質深嗜鹼並冒出許多小泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），外觀很像原始巨核細胞；但同片可見多核紅血球前驅細胞與原紅血球樣細胞，電子顯微鏡顯示胞質突起內為複雜膜狀囊泡結構，提示這其實是類似巨核細胞白血病的純紅血球白血病。
features: Medium-to-large blasts with round nuclei, finely granular chromatin and a rim of deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm (panels a, b)
Prominent cytoplasmic blebs and budding pseudopods at the cell surface, mimicking megakaryoblasts
Occasional pale perinuclear zone and small vacuoles; no Auer rods or granules
Multinucleated erythroid precursor with several round nuclei and larger proerythroblast-like cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm (panel b)
Electron microscopy: blasts with dispersed chromatin and cytoplasmic protrusions containing complex vesicular/tubular membranous structures (arrows, panels c, d)
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show a predominance of blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with conspicuous surface blebs and budding, closely resembling megakaryoblasts. Scattered multinucleated erythroid precursors and proerythroblast-like cells are also present. Ultrastructural examination shows immature cells with dispersed chromatin and cytoplasmic protrusions containing complex vesicular and tubular membrane systems (arrows). Cytoplasmic blebbing is not specific for megakaryocytic lineage, and with erythroid marker expression (E-cadherin, glycophorin/CD71, hemoglobin) and absence of CD41/CD61 the findings are consistent with pure erythroid leukemia mimicking acute megakaryoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts share blebbing but express CD41/CD61/CD42b and show platelet peroxidase on ultrastructural cytochemistry, whereas erythroblasts express E-cadherin, CD71 and glycophorin A.
MDS lacks the sheets of ≥30% proerythroblasts that define pure erythroid leukemia and shows a maturing erythroid series.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply punched-out vacuoles rather than blebs, and express mature B-cell markers with MYC rearrangement.
Non-hematopoietic tumor cells form cohesive clusters and are CD45-negative with lineage-specific markers.
